knowledge_summary.point: 家人词汇 father / mother / sister / brother / grandfather / grandmother
knowledge_summary.core_concept: father 爸爸、mother 妈妈、sister 姐妹、brother 兄弟、grandfather 爷爷/外公、grandmother 奶奶/外婆。
knowledge_summary.key_formula: father / mother / sister / brother / grandfather / grandmother
common_mistakes: sister 与 brother 性别弄反。

knowledge_summary.core_concept: Who's he? 他是谁？He is my father. Who's she? 她是谁？She is my mother. 男用 he，女用 she。
knowledge_summary.key_formula: Who's he? — He is my … / Who's she? — She is my …
